author: c05_review
coordinator_decision: Independent first gate accepted; continue authorized full author package.
methods: Exact posterior/predictive sums, finite MH flow and residual kernel, separate 81-path variance, direct lasso normal/residual/KKT checks, eight-atom AIPW, actual two-fold fitting and 144-state BH enumeration including 288 leave-one-out identities.
approved_clarifications: The constant design column is penalized along with every other lasso coefficient.
Fold assignment is predetermined or randomized independently of observations.
Use foldwise conditional variance bounds and bounded conditional-probability arguments, then fixed-K summation; do not condition on all fits and assume joint independence.
The BH zeroed-p-value identity must be proved in both directions with inclusive ties.
evidence_limit: Author-reported independent first gate; complete final author/checker and separate peer/root reviews remain required.
